title: she asked one person the same thing ten times in 100 minutes

incident.summary: One wish, to ask S how a report went, lived in three stores that did not know of each other: a proposal from memory at 09:07, a commitment made in the turn it opened, and later a goal of her Plan to ask whenever S spoke. She asked by DM at 11:07, twice, five seconds apart; S answered at 11:22 and 11:33; from 12:12 to 12:49 she asked again each time S spoke in the channel, although S said she had asked already. The times, the count and S's lines are from the sources; her own questions are paraphrased.
source: packages/types/src/wish.ts and packages/arbiter/src/wishes.ts (the incident as their comments record it)
